<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Kholo Sergeant](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3071)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

When kholos band together to form mercenary bands or raiding parties, the strongest or most respected among them is often designated the hunt leader or sergeant. These kholo are responsible for the safety and success of their packmates and train extensively in the art of war. Their skill at arms makes them powerful adversaries. A kholo sergeant might also serve as a mercenary group's leader in other affairs, such as sorting out domestic disputes or negotiating with rival kholo bands.

<column gap="tiny">

([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 19

</column>

</column>

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
scimitar +14 ([Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)),
**Damage** 1d6+7 slashing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +14 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 1d6+7 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
composite shortbow +12 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 0](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)),
**Damage** 1d6+4 piercing

**Bark Orders** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101)) The kholo sergeant commands their allies to reposition. Any allies who hear and understand this order can use a reaction to Step.

**Pack Attack**   A kholo bonekeeper deals 1d4 extra damage to any creature that's within reach of at least two of the kholo bonekeeper's allies.

**Rugged Travel**   A kholo ignores the first square of [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) they move into each time they Step or Stride.

</column>
